title: Do you need a merchant of record for a PC game web shop?
body: Selling in-game items or keys directly means handling sales tax or VAT, refunds and chargebacks in many countries. Did you use a merchant of record, or did you register and handle tax yourself, and how did the fees compare?

The [Paddle homepage](https://www.paddle.com/) describes its product as a merchant of record solution for SaaS and apps, with Nexus Mods among the customer stories it lists. The [Tebex homepage](https://www.tebex.io/) describes a game monetization extension with webstores, checkout and store protection products. Neither opened page states a fee level that we can quote.
If you run a web shop alongside a platform store, tell us how you linked accounts, what you do about refunds and what surprised you in the first quarter of selling.
